ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu; this course combines online communications (during the fall) with site-based activities. Champaign area students will meet in room 202 (505 East Green Street) Monday thru Friday from June 6 to 17 between 9 AM to 4 PM. Kankakee students meet at Bradley-Bourbonnais Community High School Monday thru Friday from July 25 to Aug 5 between 9 AM to 4 PM. Additional meetings for both groups of students will be held in Springfield on October 14 and 15 from 10 AM to 3 PM.
